jobs.description_snippet: ### **Description** Zappi is a fast-growing SaaS platform helping Fortune 500 companies pre-test new ideas and creative content before production. Our services encompass new products, media campaigns, names, logos, packaging or flavours. Zappi enables companies to shelve bad ideas and refine good ones. We bring together top expertise in applied statistics, data science, visualisation, UX and engineering to create a platform that empowers non-expert users to make high-stakes decisions easily and confidently. We are committed to running a profitable business while having a positive impact on the environment and our communities. **How we do it** Our platform provides quick, actionable insights that amplify creative effectiveness and shape winning innovation. We empower creators with the agility and data they need to make informed decisions about the ads and innovation they bring to market. Through partnerships with some of the world’s biggest brands, we’ve developed technology that allows our customers to see their product innovations and advertising ideas through the eyes of their consumers. This enables them to quickly iterate, optimize, validate and learn — increasing their chances of in-market success. **The Quality Engineering team** Our Quality Engineering team works closely with Engineering, Product, Design and other teams to build quality into the software development lifecycle, rather than treating testing as a final step before release. We combine hands-on testing, automation and exploratory testing to identify risks early and understand how our products behave from the customer's perspective. We focus on the areas where testing adds the most value, using automation to improve coverage and reduce regression risk.
